name: devops
description: Operate and secure what ships: ci (harden GitHub Actions workflows and configure Renovate: template-injection prevention, SHA-pinned actions, scoped permissions, zizmor, dependency-bot rules), security (gitleaks, trufflehog, osv-scanner, semgrep, SkillSpector, garak, nuclei, strix plus an AI triage pass) and deploy (deploy a released or integrated revision and verify it from real logs or state; a failed verification leaves the stage open with the evidence).
